newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soy seen down 3 to 5 cents on exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soy seen down 3 to 5 cents on exports.

text.p: Negative net weekly export sales were expected to push July soybeans down three to five cents a bushel at Thursday's opening, traders said.
USDA put old crop net weekly export sales at a negative 50,700 tonnes.
"The exports for beans are terrible," said a floor trader.
Wednesday's limit-down close in July beans was also expected to prompt additional selling on the open, traders said.
There were also scattered instances of cash merchandisers taking five cents per bushel protection on soybeans.
New-crop soybeans should find support from export sales of 556,200 tonnes, traders said.
